findings.title: Pagination total_pages calculation is incorrect for non-divisible item counts
findings.summary: total_pages uses integer division which truncates when items don't divide evenly into page sizes, causing has_next to incorrectly return False and preventing clients from fetching remaining pages
findings.failure_scenario: Request with 25 items and page_size=20: total_pages becomes 1 (should be 2), so page 1's has_next returns False (should be True), and page 2 never returns data
findings.evidence: Line 51: total_pages = total_items // page_size - this truncates 25//20=1 instead of 2; Line 29: has_next uses page < total_pages which fails when total_pages is understated

raised_findings.title: Float conversion in apply_discount breaks decimal precision
raised_findings.summary: The apply_discount function converts Decimal subtotal to float before multiplication, introducing binary floating-point errors that money.py explicitly warns against
raised_findings.failure_scenario: For a booking with subtotal 123.456789 and 10% discount, the calculation float(123.456789) * 10.0 / 100.0 may produce 12.3456789 due to float precision loss, then round() applies ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP, and money() quantizes incorrectly - resulting in a discount that differs from the mathematically correct value

raised_findings.title: Duration calculation truncates fractional minutes
raised_findings.summary: The duration_minutes property uses int() truncation which loses fractional minute precision in booking duration calculations
raised_findings.failure_scenario: A booking from 10:00 to 10:31 has duration_minutes = 31 (correct), but a booking from 10:00 to 10:31.5 seconds (31 minutes 30 seconds) would still be reported as 31 minutes, potentially undercharging the customer for the extra 30 seconds

raised_findings.title: Discount calculation doesn't preserve Decimal semantics
raised_findings.summary: The apply_discount function should use Decimal arithmetic throughout to match the rest of the financial calculation code
raised_findings.failure_scenario: When subtotal is 100.00 and percent is 33.33, float multiplication produces 33.32999999999999 instead of 33.33, then round() and money() compound the error, producing a discount of 33.33 instead of the correct 33.33 when calculated with Decimal precision

raised_findings.title: Idempotency key loses time precision allowing duplicate bookings for same-day different times
raised_findings.summary: Uses start.date().isoformat() which strips time information, so retries at different times on the same day produce identical idempotency keys
raised_findings.failure_scenario: Customer books resource for 9am on Jan 1st, then retries for 10am on same day - same idempotency key generated, allowing duplicate bookings for different time slots
